notes: Account brief: mid-stage code-intel startup building internal developer search for large mono-repos and multi-repo orgs.
Primary ask: scale embeddings + reranking pipeline for code search across ~2M files (estimated ~30B tokens); frequent re-indexing (daily incremental + weekly full).
Performance targets: p50 < 200ms for end-to-end retrieval+rerank for single-file queries; p95 budgeted < 500ms; target cost per user query <= $0.06 (including retrieval + LLM rerank).
Throughput: expected peak 40-60 QPS for search endpoint during dev hours; background re-index jobs produce ~5M new/updated embeddings per day during active cycles.

Preferred architecture: vector index (sharded FAISS/HNSW) + lightweight ANN for recall + LLM-based reranker for top-20 -> rank top-3. Wants deterministic fallbacks to smaller quantized models when capacity limited.

Security/regulatory: SSO/SAML + SCIM for user provisioning; must pass ISO27001 internal audit within 90 days; audit logs retained 13 months; want KMS integration for keys and optional on-prem HSM for private deployments.

Integration constraints: internal CI/CD enforces ephemeral tokens, no external storage for raw source code in hosted provider unless encrypted at rest and restricted by VPC. Prefer private Redwood deployment in customer VPC or on-prem appliance for initial production rollout.

POC scope (agreed): ingest 10 representative repos (~10M files), run full pipeline (tokenization -> embeddings -> index -> rerank), measure MRR and latency, validate incremental indexing flow and SAML SSO with their Okta tenant.

POC success metrics: MRR uplift >= 12% over baseline BM25, median query latency < 200ms, reindex sustained throughput >= 3M embeddings/day without spike failures, confirm SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning end-to-end.
